Examples:

- Improve onboarding
- Reduce checkout abandonment
- Simplify navigation
- Increase conversions

# QA Validation

# Implementation Checklist

☐ Figma Linked

☐ Components Documented

☐ Assets Exported

☐ Responsive Rules Defined

☐ Accessibility Reviewed

☐ Technical Notes Completed

☐ Acceptance Criteria Approved

☐ Engineering Review Completed

---

# Governance

Approval authority:

- UX Design Office
- Engineering Lead
- Product Owner

Development shall not begin until the handoff package has been approved.

---

# AI Consumption Notes

AI may assist with:

- Design documentation
- Component inventory
- Accessibility validation
- Responsive recommendations
- Acceptance criteria generation
- Handoff quality review

AI-generated implementation guidance shall be verified against the approved design before development begins.
